:::{#def-euclidean-distance}
#### Euclidean distance

The **Euclidean distance** between two vectors $\vx$ and $\vy$ of length $p$
is the [Euclidean norm](#def-euclidean-norm) of their difference:

$$d(\vx, \vy) \eqdef \norm{\vx - \vy} = \sqrt{\sumip (x_i - y_i)^2}$$ {#eq-euclidean-distance}

:::
